settings.title: Good climate work starts with clear questions.
settings.subtitle: FAQ
settings.description: Four practical answers for this fictional demonstration template.

tabs.tab_title: Do we need perfect data to start?
tabs.tab_content: No. A useful first baseline can document estimates and gaps clearly, then improve evidence quality over time.

tabs.tab_title: Does Beacon provide assurance or certification?
tabs.tab_content: No. This fictional consultancy template does not represent an assurance, audit or certification service. Replace the copy with accurate service terms.

tabs.tab_title: Can this work with an existing sustainability plan?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. The method can organize existing goals, data and initiatives into a clearer decision and reporting rhythm.

tabs.tab_title: Are the figures on this page real?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every percentage and emissions figure is illustrative demo content and must be replaced before real-world publication.
